syn_text: Starting materials: lead chloride (PbCl2), methylammonium hydrochloride (CH3NH3Cl), dimethylformamide (DMF), dimethyl sulfoxide (DMSO). Product: MAPbCl3 single crystals. 0.2228 g of CH3NH3Cl was dissolved in 3.3 mL DMSO:DMF (1:1) solution using an ultrasonic bath for 10 minutes under an N2 atmosphere at room temperature. 0.8343 g PbCl2 was added and stirred for 20 min until the solution became transparent. The solution was filtered using a PVDF filter, transferred to a vial and kept in an oil bath undisturbed at 50 C for 6-8 h. The crystals were dried with a nitrogen gun.
exp_text: Photoluminescence measurement at 300 K. PL spectrum was recorded with a HORIBA iHR-550 spectrometer, liquid-nitrogen cooled CCD detector, and semiconductor laser operated at 266 nm.

syn_text: Starting materials: MACl, PbCl2. Product: MAPbCl3. 420 mg, 6.22 mmol MACl and 1.73 g, 6.22 mmol PbCl2 were dissolved in 3.1 mL of DMSO. The solution was kept at 110 C for 24 h. The crystals were collected by filtration.
exp_text: Single crystal X-ray diffraction. SCXRD was measured at 100 K on a Bruker AXS Apex 1 diffractometer using Mo Ka radiation, wavelength 0.71073 angstrom. The structure was solved by direct methods using SHELXT and refined by full-matrix least-squares against F^2 using SHELXL.

syn_text: TOY RECORD FOR TESTING. MABr and PbBr2 were dissolved in DMF and heated to 80 C to grow MAPbBr3 single crystals by inverse temperature crystallization.
exp_text: TOY RECORD FOR TESTING. Photoluminescence measured at room temperature with 405 nm laser excitation.

syn_text: TOY RECORD FOR TESTING. MAI and PbI2 were dissolved in DMF:DMSO and spin coated onto glass; chlorobenzene antisolvent was dripped and the film annealed at 100 C for 10 min.
exp_text: TOY RECORD FOR TESTING. Steady-state photoluminescence of the thin film at 300 K, excitation 532 nm.

syn_text: TOY RECORD FOR TESTING. CsPbBr3 nanocrystals were made by hot injection of Cs-oleate into PbBr2 in octadecene with oleic acid and oleylamine at 170 C.
